We are a nationally recognized Microsoft Partner of the Year and the largest, leading IT service provider headquartered in San Diego. Essential Duties/Responsibilities The Senior Network Engineer is a senior network resource working across Managed Solution's Managed and Professional Services departments to design, deliver, and support client networks and serve as a senior escalation resource for Managed Services customers. Working on assignments made under standard project practices, this role delivers SD-WAN, firewall, switching, wireless, and hybrid cloud network projects from discovery through cutover, advises clients on network strategy and budgeting, and supports presales scoping and design with oversight from the architect team. The role is also a point of escalation for advanced network troubleshooting from the Managed Operations Center and Technical Account Manager teams. Success in this role requires strong customer advisory skills, a strong understanding of Managed Services contracts and scoping, and flexibility to support migrations and outages outside of standard business hours. They will be responsible for the following: Managed Services Escalation Support Serves as a senior escalation resource for advanced network, SD-WAN, and firewall issues escalated by the Network Support Specialist, Level 2, the Shift Lead, Helpdesk Support Services, and the Technical Account Manager team, providing advanced troubleshooting and oversight of resolution efforts and, where needed, hands-on engineering. Coordinates with the Senior Network Security Engineer and, where available, the Senior Network Architect so each escalation has a clear owner. Depending on the customer, the skillset required, and the nature of the issue, an escalation may go to the Senior Network Security Engineer instead of or in addition to this role, and to the Senior Network Architect for architectural or cross-client critical issues. Supports migrations, scheduled change windows, and outage response outside of standard business hours, including participating in the after-hours on-call rotation, and communicates clearly with clients and internal teams during outages. Reviews SD-WAN health, firewall security ratings, firmware advisories, and configuration drift, performs root-cause analysis, and drives remediation through change control. Client Consulting + Presales Advises clients on network strategy, lifecycle refresh, and budgeting, recommending right-sized, budget-appropriate solutions for small and mid-sized business clients, and presents designs, findings, and recommendations to client IT leaders and executives in clear business terms, in coordination with the Technical Account Manager, who retains ownership of the client relationship. Supports presales by scoping network projects and drafting designs, hours estimates, bills of materials, and Statement of Work and Rough Order of Magnitude input, with oversight from the architect team and in coordination with the Presales Solutions Architect or Solution Architects on the network-specific aspects of requested work. Applies a strong understanding of Managed Services contracts and scoping to distinguish work covered by a client’s contract from out-of-scope work, and routes out-of-scope work through Account Management and the Technical Account Manager as a project. Deploys Fortinet SD-WAN and security policy with FortiSwitch and FortiAP infrastructure, including VLANs, firewall policies, NAT, DHCP, and addressing. Leads high-risk migrations as technical owner, such as replacing legacy firewalls and WAN platforms, consolidating separate networks into one architecture, and moving sites from VPN meshes or single circuits to SD-WAN, and plans and executes office moves and relocations with full production validation. Standards, Documentation + Mentoring Receives technical direction from Architects, where that role is in place, and from other architects as assigned, and applies and helps maintain network standards, SD-WAN and firewall configuration templates, and baselines. Maintains configuration backups, network diagrams, IP address plans, and runbooks, and holds the team to the same documentation standard. Mentors network and project engineers and reviews their changes. Performance + Compliance Consistently meets or exceeds objectives and key performance indicators for the role, as established by the Senior Microsoft Solutions Architect. Models the One Technical Team pillars: Accountability, Utilization, and Engagement. Complies with all company and client policies and maintains the confidentiality of company and client information. Performs all related duties as assigned by supervisor. Requirements Education and Work Experience Requirements: A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, plus 6+ years of hands-on network engineering experience, including 2+ years leading network projects or designs. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered. 2+ years designing, deploying, and supporting SD-WAN in production multi-site environments. 3+ years of experience in a managed service provider or similar outsourced IT environment supporting multiple clients, including small and mid-sized business (SMB) clients, with a strong understanding of Managed Services contracts and scoping. Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, and supporting networks across an SMB client portfolio, including right-sizing solutions to SMB budgets and staffing and standardizing repeatable designs for single-site and small multi-site clients. Strong customer advisory skills, including exceptional written and verbal communication and the ability to explain technical design choices, budgets, and change risk to non-technical client stakeholders and executives. Calm, methodical troubleshooting under pressure during outages and cutovers. Ability to work autonomously, prioritize across multiple clients, and own work through to completion. Coaching mindset: reviews others’ work constructively and raises team standards. Technical Skills/Competencies SD-WAN design and operations, including overlay and underlay design, performance SLAs and health checks, application-aware steering, dual-ISP failover, and troubleshooting. Fortinet Secure SD-WAN strongly preferred. Deep knowledge of TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs and 802.1Q trunking, spanning tree, NAT, DHCP and DNS, and static and dynamic routing (BGP, OSPF). Hands-on administration of next-generation firewalls, with Fortinet FortiGate and FortiManager required. Working knowledge of Cisco (Catalyst, Nexus, Firepower, and ASA) and Meraki environments sufficient to take escalations from the Managed Operations Center. Right-sizing network designs and platform selection for SMB and mid-market environments (for example, entry and mid-range firewalls, wireless, and switching), balancing cost, security, and supportability. Designing and troubleshooting site-to-site and remote-access VPNs (IPsec and SSL). Azure networking, including VNets, VPN gateways, NSGs, user-defined routes, and network virtual appliance high availability. Enterprise wireless deployment and troubleshooting, including 802.1X authentication. Disciplined documentation and change management within a ticketing system (ConnectWise preferred). Preferred: Aryaka and Palo Alto experience; FortiAnalyzer, FortiSwitch, and FortiAP administration at scale; other SD-WAN platforms and migrating clients off them; Windows Server networking roles (NPS/RADIUS, Certificate Services, DNS, and DHCP); healthcare or other regulated environment experience; SASE or zero trust network access design; and scripting or automation for network tasks. Certifications: Fortinet NSE 4 (FortiOS Administrator, or prior equivalent) required. Fortinet NSE 6 covering SD-WAN (or prior equivalent) required within 6 months of hire if not already held. Fortinet NSE 7, Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700) or Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), and Cisco CCNP Enterprise preferred. Attaining and maintaining technical certifications may be required for continued employment. Availability + Other Requirements: This position's normal workweek will be Monday through Friday, with hours to be agreed upon based on Company needs. Managed Solution operates in Pacific Time Zone, though some scheduling flexibility may be offered for employees in other regions. Managed Solution operates a 24x7x365 business. This role requires availability for after-hours maintenance windows, migrations, and on-call escalation in support of Managed Solution’s 24x7 operations. Travel to client sites of up to 25% may be required. Individuals in this role will be subject to a pre-hire background screening and reference check process and, as members of the One Technical Team, may be subject to additional screening as required by client contracts, which may include drug tests. The Sr. Cloud Engineer will lead cloud transformation initiatives, drive workload modernization, and deliver scalable, resilient, and cost-effective solutions that support critical business operations worldwide. The ideal candidate is a cloud-focused technical leader with deep expertise in cloud architecture, cloud-native technologies, hybrid cloud infrastructure, automation, and Infrastructure as Code. This individual will help define cloud strategy, establish engineering standards, and lead migrations from traditional on-premises VMware environments to Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, and Google Cloud Platform. The role also requires the ability to operate and improve core on-premises platforms, including VMware virtualization, Pure Storage Fibre Channel infrastructure, Quest backup and recovery tools, and F5 load-balancing services. This position serves as a senior technical advisor for cloud architecture, migration, modernization, reliability, security, and operational excellence across cloud and on-premises environments. The successful candidate will partner with cybersecurity, networking, application development, enterprise architecture, and business teams to deliver hybrid solutions that improve scalability, resilience, operational efficiency, and business agility across a global enterprise. Develop cloud architectures, landing-zone patterns, governance standards, roadmaps, and workload-placement guidance. Evaluate emerging cloud technologies and serve as a senior technical advisor and escalation resource. Cloud Transformation & Migration Lead assessment, migration, and modernization efforts from VMware-based environments to public cloud platforms. Design hybrid-cloud connectivity and migration plans covering dependencies, cutover, rollback, validation, and operational transition. Drive cloud adoption that improves agility, resilience, scalability, and operational efficiency. Hybrid & On-Premises Infrastructure Support the operation, lifecycle management, capacity planning, patching, and reliability of on-premises VMware compute environments, with emphasis on maintaining stable hybrid services while workloads transition to the cloud. Administer and troubleshoot Pure Storage arrays and Fibre Channel SAN connectivity in partnership with server, storage, and network teams. Configure and troubleshoot F5 load balancers, including application delivery, traffic management, health monitoring, SSL/TLS enablement, and high-availability configurations across on-premises and hybrid services. Cloud-Native Platforms & Automation Architect and support Kubernetes-based platforms, including AKS, EKS, and GKE. Implement Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, Bash, APIs, and Git-based workflows. Automate provisioning, configuration, policy enforcement, monitoring, backup, and lifecycle management. Security, Reliability & Operations Establish cloud security, identity, governance, compliance, observability, and operational standards. Design highly available and recoverable cloud and on-premises services aligned with business continuity, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery requirements. Support FinOps, cloud resource optimization, hybrid infrastructure incident response, global on-call, and planned maintenance activities. Collaborate with global teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to deliver strategic cloud initiatives. Monitoring, logging, observability, operational analytics, and incident troubleshooting. High availability, enterprise backup and recovery, restore validation, replication, disaster recovery, business continuity, and RPO/RTO planning across cloud and on-premises platforms. Hybrid infrastructure including VMware virtualization and VMware Cloud Foundation, Windows/Linux, Pure Storage arrays, Fibre Channel SAN, Cisco networking, Quest backup and recovery tools, F5 load balancers, Zerto, and enterprise data protection. PKI, SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle management, Sectigo services, and certificate automation. FinOps, rightsizing, reservations, tagging, budgets, cost allocation, and resource optimization. Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Proven experience designing enterprise cloud architectures and leading large-scale migration or modernization initiatives. Experience migrating VMware workloads to public cloud platforms. Hands-on experience supporting production on-premises infrastructure, including VMware virtualization and at least two of the following: Pure Storage with Fibre Channel SAN, Quest backup and recovery tools, or F5 load balancers. Experience architecting or operating Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure services. Expert-level experience with Infrastructure as Code, automation, and repeatable provisioning practices. Experience establishing cloud governance, security, reliability, and operational standards in a global enterprise. Ability to collaborate effectively across regions, cultures, technical teams, and time zones. Preferred Qualifications One or more relevant certifications are preferred: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or OCI Architect Professional. Certified Kubernetes Administrator, Certified Kubernetes Application Developer, or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist. HashiCorp Terraform Associate or Professional, or Red Hat Ansible Automation certification. CCSP, CCSK, CISSP, or a comparable cloud security certification. FinOps Certified Practitioner or Professional. VMware VCP/VCAP/VCF, F5 Certified Administrator, or ITIL Foundation certification.
